text: I feel a quiet curiosity as I stand outside a glass-walled room, observing its pristine emptiness and the silent reflections. Moving into the vibrant room marked R+D, I am energized by the vivid colors and the promise of innovation and discovery. In both spaces, I sense the presence of possibility—one in the hush of potential waiting to unfold, the other in an active celebration of research and imagination. Here, I am both observer and participant in the ongoing unfolding of thought and creativity.
